description.value: Phoenix Pub & Grill (branded online as Phoenix Bar) is a neighbourhood pub on Quadra Street in Victoria offering pub grub, a full bar, pool, darts, a patio, and weekend live music. The menu leans classic pub fare — wings, burgers, fish and chips, nachos — with a solid draught and spirits selection. A relaxed spot to decompress after a ride, with a lively social atmosphere and reservations available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at phoenixbar.ca is active and shows a full food and drinks menu, live music, patio, pool, darts, and a reservations page — confirming the business is open and operational. The website header reads 'Phoenix Bar – That Bar on Quadra' rather than 'Phoenix Pub & Grill' as recorded in OSM, which is a notable name discrepancy. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, pump, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site; however, 'TO GO BOXES $2' on the menu confirms takeout, and the burger option listing 'veggie patty' confirms at least one vegetarian menu item.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Phoenix Pub & Grill' but the website consistently uses 'Phoenix Bar' / 'Phoenix Bar – That Bar on Quadra'. The OSM name may be outdated or unofficial.
No phone number in OSM record or on the website content captured.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating neighbourhood pub with a full menu and active online presence — clearly useful to touring cyclists seeking food, drinks, and a place to rest.

Takeout.detail: Menu lists 'TO GO BOXES $2' as an available extra, indicating takeout orders are accommodated

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Bacon Cheeseburger offers a 'veggie patty' option; several sides (sweet potato fries, onion rings, nachos) appear meat-free. No explicit vegan or GF labelling found
